fields.name: 1 canonical authority, object and exact theorem targets per obligation
2 Rust layout, entry points, identity, merge, refusal and bounds
3 Song layout, entry points, stride, keys, probes, merge and transactionality
4 separate Rust and Song admission predicates
5 separate Rust and Song resource accounts
6 source-connected refinement and a named rejecting control

canonical.object: A table is the total function Apeiron.Table.HMap K V := K -> V. Absence is the stored default, not a partial lookup; reading is Apeiron.Table.get. The physical layout is related to that function only by the read-only extensional Rep relation proved at the concrete N = 16 word instance; no physical-layout invariant is claimed.

rust.layout: Table<K, V, H, N> holds default: V, home: H, and shards: [Option<[Option<(K, V)>; N]>; 256]: 256 inline shards, each an optional array of at most N key/value slots. Storage never allocates; N defaults to 16.

entry_points.role: constructor; all shards None, default stored

rust.identity: Placement is home(key) mod 256 (shard_index); identity is full-key equality in find_slots (stored == key). Shard truncation selects a shard and never replaces full-key identity.
rust.merge: This subprofile selects the replacement merge merge(new, old) = new, realized by a Merge<V> instance. WordMerge (wrapping add) is the R1 merge and is excluded here.
rust.refusal: Refusal is StorageError::ShardFull, a checked storage admission failure, not an allocator error.
rust.bounds: No heap nodes: the shards array is inline. Object size grows with N and the constant 256 shard count.

song.layout: tableInit / tableInitGo write key TABLE_EMPTY and value 0 into cap slots. Each slot is two consecutive cells, key at base + 2*slot and value at base + 2*slot + 1, so initialization writes 2*cap cells.
song.stride: TABLE_STRIDE = 2. Key and value are adjacent cells; no other cell layout is selected.
song.keys: A live slot has a key other than TABLE_EMPTY. TABLE_EMPTY = 0 - 1 is the reserved empty key, so -1 is not an admissible live key. Live keys are unique and a missing key reads as -1.
song.probes: tableFindSlotGo and tableLookupSlotGo walk (slot + step) and mask for step in 0..cap; a live key must be reachable before any empty slot in its probe sequence.
song.merge: The layout is merge-agnostic; the selected merge is MERGE_MAP in T3.
song.transactionality: tableInsertWith writes one slot in place; there is no rollback and no deletion is selected.

rust.predicate: insert_with refuses with StorageError::ShardFull exactly when the key is absent and its home shard has no vacant slot; N = 0 refuses every write; reads are total. Refusal invokes neither clone nor merge and changes no field.

song.predicate: tableInsertWith refuses with TABLE_EMPTY = -1 when tableCapacityOk(cap) is 0, when key is TABLE_EMPTY, when the merge code is outside MERGE_SET..MERGE_ACC, or when tableFindSlotGo exhausts cap probes. tableGet and tableFind refuse a missing key with -1.

rust.accounting: 0 heap nodes; the 256 shards are inline
constant call depth; a scalar loop index only

song.accounting: 0 allocated nodes; caller or static memory

canonical.object: get reads the value at a key. The canonical table is total, so an unwritten key reads the default and a written key reads its stored value.

rust.layout: get computes the home shard, scans it with full-key equality, and returns the stored override or &self.default on a miss.
rust.identity: find_slots compares the full stored key; a collision that shares the home residue is not the read key.
rust.refusal: Reads are total; there is no read refusal and no sentinel return.
rust.bounds: At most N full-key inspections per read.

song.layout: tableGet calls tableFind and reads tableSlotVal at the located slot; a missing key returns TABLE_EMPTY = -1.

entry_points.role: probe for a key, returning slot or -1

song.stride: The read address is base + TABLE_STRIDE * slot + 1, one cell after the key.
song.keys: tableGet has no stored default: an absent key and a key holding value -1 both return -1. The occupied key must be read separately.
song.probes: tableFind returns -1 on an empty slot or after cap probes.

rust.predicate: get is total for every key. No admission predicate guards a read.

song.predicate: tableGet returns TABLE_EMPTY = -1 for a missing key and for the reserved key -1. A -1 raw return is overloaded and is not a status.

rust.accounting: up to N full-key comparisons per read
one home callback and one residue per read

song.accounting: up to cap steps of tableLookupSlotGo, measure cap - step
one tableSpread multiply and mask per read

canonical.object: insertWith f k v m := fun x => if x = k then f v (m x) else m x. This subprofile fixes f to replacement, f v old = v, so a write overwrites the stored value and leaves other keys untouched. merge_is_the_only_freedom shows insertWith depends on f only through its values.

rust.layout: insert_with locates the key in its home shard, replaces the stored value for a present key, or installs the merged value at the first vacant slot for an absent key.

entry_points.role: value combination trait; the replacement instance is selected
wrapping-add merge, excluded from this subprofile

rust.identity: The write updates only the slot whose full key equals the argument; a same-residue collision is a different key.
rust.merge: Replacement: merge(value, old) = value. WordMerge and any wrapping addition are excluded from the matched merge of this subprofile.
rust.refusal: A present key always updates, even in a full shard. An absent key in a full shard refuses with StorageError::ShardFull.
rust.bounds: One full-key scan of the home shard to locate the key, then at most N vacancy inspections.

song.layout: tableInsertWith probes with tableFindSlotGo, then either updates the located present slot or fills the first empty probe slot.
song.stride: The write address is base + TABLE_STRIDE * slot for the key and + 1 for the value.
song.keys: The reserved key -1 is refused before probing; a present key is located by full-key equality in tableFindSlotGo.
song.probes: At most cap probes; a present key updates in place, an absent key fills the first empty slot.
song.merge: MERGE_MAP computes newVal = value, the replacement merge. MERGE_SET (presence 1) and MERGE_ACC are outside this subprofile's matched merge; MERGE_ACC adds oldVal + value only on the existing-key path and stores value unchanged for a fresh key.
song.transactionality: The write mutates one slot in place and returns the new value; there is no rollback.

rust.predicate: The replacement Merge admits every (i64, i64). Admission is inherited from insert_with: a present key always admits; an absent key admits iff its home shard has a vacant slot.

song.predicate: tableInsertWith with MERGE_MAP admits only when tableCapacityOk(cap) is nonzero, key is not TABLE_EMPTY, merge is in MERGE_SET..MERGE_ACC, and tableFindSlotGo returns a slot. A full probe sequence refuses with -1.

rust.accounting: replacement merge is constant work; one home callback and residue
one full-key scan of the home shard, at most N comparisons

song.accounting: one tableSpread multiply and mask; MERGE_MAP assigns value
up to cap steps of tableFindSlotGo, measure cap - step

canonical.object: The canonical insertWith is total and has no refusal. On success the implementation post-state denotes insertWith; on resource exhaustion the implementations refuse and the profile states whether state changes. The canonical build is the only composition form.

rust.layout: A refusal returns StorageError::ShardFull and the table value is unchanged.
rust.identity: A refusal is for an absent key only; a present key in a full shard updates rather than refuses.
rust.merge: Refusal invokes neither clone nor merge.
rust.refusal: StorageError::ShardFull exactly when the key is absent and its home shard has no vacant slot. Refusal changes no field (word_table_shardFull_refusal at N = 16).
rust.bounds: For an absent key in an initialized full shard, the refusal path performs N full-key search inspections followed by N vacancy inspections, then returns without writing.

song.layout: A refusal returns TABLE_EMPTY = -1. Because tableInsertWith writes in place, a refusal after earlier writes leaves those writes in place.
song.keys: The reserved key -1 is refused before any write; a missing read is also -1, so the raw return does not distinguish them.
song.probes: Refusal occurs when all cap probes are occupied.
song.merge: A refused MERGE_MAP write does not merge.
song.transactionality: The insertion loop mutates its prefix: earlier successful writes remain after a later refusal. This is not transactional.

rust.predicate: insert_with refuses exactly on an absent key whose home shard is full; the refusal post-state equals the pre-state. N = 0 refuses every write.

song.predicate: tableInsertWith refuses with -1 on invalid capacity, reserved key, out-of-range merge code, or probe exhaustion; the refusal post-state is unchanged for the refused call but retains the caller's earlier writes.

rust.accounting: N full-key search inspections followed by N vacancy inspections on the refusal path

song.accounting: at most cap probe steps before refusal

refinement.source_connected: Rust: word_table_shardFull_refusal proves the absent-key full-shard refusal with an unchanged state at N = 16. Song: no checked refinement of the refusal post-state exists; the in-place prefix mutation is the B6 blocker.

canonical.object: The canonical definitions are total and resource-free; resource bounds belong to each implementation and are not identified across layouts. No canonical theorem carries a cost.

rust.layout: Cost is counted on the inline fixed-shard table: at most N full-key search inspections, then up to N vacancy inspections.
rust.identity: The search bound is N full-key comparisons per shard.
rust.merge: The replacement merge is constant work; the excluded WordMerge would add one wrapping addition per successful insert.
rust.refusal: A full shard costs the full N vacancy inspections before refusing.
rust.bounds: At most N search inspections then up to N vacancy inspections per insert_with; 0 heap nodes; constant call depth with object size growing with N.

song.layout: Cost is counted on the caller memory table: at most cap probe steps.

song.stride: Each probe reads two cells; no allocation.
song.keys: The probe bound counts key comparisons and empty-slot stops.
song.probes: At most cap probes; recursion depth bounded by cap; measure cap - step.
song.merge: MERGE_MAP is constant work; MERGE_ACC would add one addition on the existing-key path only, a fresh key storing value unchanged.
song.transactionality: No input consumption: the primitive reads and writes caller memory[]. 0 allocated nodes.

rust.predicate: The bound is part of admission only through the N-slot shard capacity; it does not admit or refuse independently of insert_with.

song.predicate: The bound is part of admission only through tableCapacityOk(cap) and the cap-probe exhaustion; backing and extent are separate obligations.

targets.hypotheses: hcomm : forall a b, f a b = f b a; hassoc : forall a b c, f (f a b) c = f a (f b c)

rust.layout: build constructs a fresh table and folds insert_with over kvs in order.
rust.identity: The built table is the per-key replacement fold; the last value at a key wins.
rust.refusal: build returns Err(StorageError::ShardFull) at the first refused insertion; no partial table is returned.
rust.bounds: build consumes kvs in order, cloning each key and value; no partial table on refusal.

song.layout: Song has only per-insert tableInsertWith plus tableInit; there is no transactional build.
song.stride: Each loop iteration writes one slot in place.
song.keys: A refused iteration leaves the keys written by earlier iterations live.
song.probes: Per-iteration probes are bounded by cap; the loop length is the caller's.
song.transactionality: The insertion loop mutates its prefix and is not transactional. This is the B6 composition blocker, not a matched primitive.

rust.predicate: build admits a stream iff every prefix insertion is admitted; the first refusal makes the whole build Err.

song.predicate: There is no build admission predicate; each tableInsertWith call is admitted independently.

rust.accounting: consumes kvs in order and clones each key and value
0 heap nodes; the built table is inline

The replacement-merge build composition is established at N = 16 by Apeiron.Joint.TableInstance.replacement_build and Apeiron.Joint.TableInstance.replacement_build_get_acc, with Apeiron.Joint.TableInstance.replacement_shardFull_refusal covering the refusal branch, in proof/corpus/Joint/TableInstance.lean against canonical Apeiron.Table.build; the universal physical Rep is still open. separate_admission.rust: insert_with refuses with StorageError::ShardFull exactly when the key is absent and its home shard has no vacant slot; N = 0 refuses every write; reads are total.
separate_admission.song: tableInsertWith refuses with TABLE_EMPTY = -1 on invalid capacity, reserved key, out-of-range merge code, or probe exhaustion; tableGet and tableFind refuse a missing key with -1.
separate_admission.joint: Joint success requires both admission predicates. A write is matched only when the Rust insert_with returns Ok and the Song tableInsertWith returns the merged value for the same key and value.
separate_admission.unequal_capacities: The Rust shard capacity N and the Song power-of-two capacity cap are different resources, so unequal capacities need not give identical refusals. A key admitted by one side may be refused by the other; the matched domain is the intersection, not either predicate alone.

hazards.statement: Song returns -1 for a missing read while Rust returns the stored default. Song's raw return is not a reliable success/refusal tag: -1 conflates a missing read, an empty slot, invalid capacity, the reserved key, an out-of-range merge code and a full table.
hazards.consequence: A consumer that treats the raw return as a status misclassifies a missing read as a refusal, or a refusal as a read. The matched status relation is open.

hazards.statement: A consumer needing unambiguous success/refusal status needs an executing adapter that separates the Song raw word from the occupied-key state; no such adapter exists in this subprofile.
hazards.consequence: Until the adapter executes and is checked, the joint success/refusal relation is not established, and no row closes on the raw return alone.

hazards.statement: Values equal to -1 are legitimate: a live key may hold value -1, and MERGE_MAP can store it.
hazards.consequence: A -1 return cannot be read as missing without checking the occupied key separately; a sentinel-value success would be misclassified as a missing read.

hazards.statement: The occupied-key set must be retained separately from the extensional map. Rust distinguishes an unwritten key (default) from a written key whose value equals the default; Song's extensional read alone cannot.
hazards.consequence: The joint representation must carry occupied keys, not only the map, or the correspondence is false for a written key whose value equals the default.

controls.name: collision-key substitution
controls.mutation: In a throwaway copy, substitute a key that shares the home residue (for example 0 -> 256) for a present key in the Rust source and in the Song source, then re-run the read and the write.
controls.expected_red: The read and the update must locate the original full key and must not report or overwrite the collision key. Rust: oneSlots_find and table_insert_present_zero. Song: the probe-reachability check.
controls.grade: spec-level control; not executed by this checker

controls.name: lost probe continuation
controls.mutation: In a throwaway Song copy, remove the step + 1 continuation in tableFindSlotGo and tableLookupSlotGo so each probe returns after the first step.
controls.expected_red: A key placed after a collision becomes unreachable and a later insert duplicates it. The in-tree tablefindslotgo_bound and tablelookupslotgo_bound and the probe-reachability check must fail.
controls.grade: spec-level control; not executed by this checker

controls.name: wrong fresh merge/default
controls.mutation: In a throwaway generated copy, change the Rust fresh write merge value default to merge default value; on the Song side, make MERGE_MAP merge with the old value instead of replacing.
controls.expected_red: table_insert_empty_zero must fail on the Rust side, and the Song replacement face must no longer denote insertWith.
controls.grade: spec-level control; not executed by this checker

controls.name: full-table existing-key refusal
controls.mutation: In a throwaway copy, make a full home shard refuse an existing key instead of updating it.
controls.expected_red: The existing-key update in a full shard must still succeed. The Rust test full_shard_refuses_unchanged_but_existing_key_still_updates and the present-key refinement insert_with_present_exact must fail.
controls.grade: spec-level control; not executed by this checker

controls.name: sentinel-value success misclassification
controls.mutation: In a throwaway adapter copy, classify a -1 raw return as missing regardless of the occupied key.
controls.expected_red: A legitimate stored -1 written under MERGE_MAP must be misread as missing, so the adapter status check and the sentinel-value fixture must fail.
controls.grade: spec-level control; not executed by this checker

controls.name: mutation on refusal
controls.mutation: In a throwaway copy, write a field on a Rust ShardFull refusal, or write a slot on a refused Song insert.
controls.expected_red: The refusal post-state must equal the pre-state. Rust word_table_shardFull_refusal must fail; the Song refused-call post-state check must fail.
controls.grade: spec-level control; not executed by this checker
